item.title: HDC Begins Investigating Town Council Option
item.description: Harborough District Council has started the process of exploring whether Market Harborough should have its own town council. The move follows a petition signed by more than 1,800 residents and was formally agreed by councillors at a meeting last night. item.title: Illuminated Sculpture Planned For Friendship Park
item.description: Plans have been unveiled for a new illuminated sculpture at Market Harborough’s Friendship Park. The three-metre-tall cylindrical steel artwork will feature friendship-themed words and phrases, which will be projected onto the park’s pathways after dark. item.title: Flood Alert For Welland Valley
